title: Kisan Saathi (Agriculture & Crop Care)
description: Offline agricultural advisor: crop diseases, soil health, fertilizer dosing, weather precautions, and government schemes.

chunks.title: Wheat Nitrogen Deficiency & Correction
chunks.text: Nitrogen deficiency in wheat causes yellowing of lower leaves, stunted plant height, and reduced tillering. Correction: Apply 60 kg/ha urea at basal dose and top-dress remaining 60 kg/ha in two splits during crown root initiation (CRI, 21 days) and heading stage. Ensure soil has adequate moisture.

chunks.title: Wheat Rust (Yellow and Brown) Identification & Treatment
chunks.text: Yellow/Stripe Rust appears as bright yellow linear pustules arranged in parallel lines on leaf blades. Brown/Leaf rust appears as scattered circular orange-brown pustules. Spray Propiconazole 25% EC at 1 ml/litre or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC at 1 ml/litre immediately upon sighting. Repeat in 15 days if infection persists.

chunks.title: Rice Blast Disease Management
chunks.text: Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae) manifests as spindle-shaped or diamond lesions with greyish centres and brown margins on leaves, collars, and neck. Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP at 0.6 g/litre water or Isoprothiolane 40% EC at 1.5 ml/litre. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer during cloudy weather.

chunks.title: Phosphorus and Potassium Deficiencies
chunks.text: Phosphorus deficiency shows purplish or dark bronze discoloration on leaf edges and stunted roots; correct by applying Diammonium Phosphate (DAP) at 100 kg/ha at sowing. Potassium deficiency causes burning/scorching along leaf tips and margins; correct with MOP (Muriate of Potash) before flowering stage.

chunks.title: Cotton Pink Bollworm Control
chunks.text: Pink bollworm damages flower buds ('rosette flowers') and seeds inside developing bolls. Install pheromone traps at 5 traps/acre for monitoring. If catches exceed 8 moths/trap for 3 consecutive days, spray Profenofos 50% EC at 2 ml/litre or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC at 0.3 ml/litre.

chunks.title: Drip Irrigation Water Savings & Soil Testing
chunks.text: Drip irrigation delivers water directly to plant root zones, saving 40-60% water over flood irrigation while boosting crop yields by 20-30%. Soil pH between 6.0 and 7.5 is optimal for nutrient uptake. Apply agricultural lime (CaCO3) for acidic soils (pH < 6.0) and gypsum for alkaline soils (pH > 8.2).

chunks.title: PM-Kisan & Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
chunks.text: Under PM-KISAN, eligible landholding farmer families receive direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 via DBT. Under PMFBY, premium rates are 2% for Kharif food/oilseeds, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops, covering post-harvest and localized calamities.

chunks.title: Organic Pest Repellents (Neemastra & Bramhastra)
chunks.text: Neemastra formula: 5 kg crushed neem leaves + 5 litres cow urine + 2 kg cow dung fermented in 100 litres water for 48 hours; controls sucking pests and caterpillars. Bramhastra: Boil crushed neem, custard apple, papaya, and guava leaves in cow urine; spray at 30 ml per litre for borers.
